properties.error_model: Refusing on ANY mismatch would be worse than the problem, so schema growth is tolerated and only a real incompatibility refuses. A file it cannot read is reported as unreadable, never assumed compatible.
properties.name: Provenance sidecar — which reflow2 wrote this graph, and what this seat last synced with, written beside the store
properties.operations: read on open; write on export and on import (record_sync)
properties.payload_schema: Files beside the store, written and read by `crates/reflow2-core/src/provenance.rs`: which reflow2 vintage wrote this graph, and `last_synced` — the path-to-content-hash record a seat believes is at each target.
